head: working-tree
subject: MQTT $SYS accepted socket count
change: The broker now keeps a lock-free cumulative sockets_accepted counter, incremented once for every transport a listener hands to the broker before any policy, capacity or CONNECT outcome. Broker.stats() exposes it, the retained $SYS snapshot publishes $SYS/broker/connections/socket/count, and Prometheus exposition adds mqtt_broker_sockets_accepted_total. The counter is process-local and is not restored from snapshots, matching Mosquitto's cumulative socket-connection counter.

tests.unit: src/mqtt/broker.zig checks the topic string. src/mqtt/broker_tests.zig expects one accepted socket in the coherent retained statistics test. src/mqtt/broker/prometheus.zig checks the new counter family line.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='Prometheus exposition' -Dtest-filter='coherent retained system statistics' -Dtest-filter='SYS version and client aliases' --summary all

notes: sockets_accepted counts transports that reached the broker accept path, so TLS handshake failures before that boundary and capacity refusals before CONNECT are counted but pre-broker TLS failures are not. Mosquitto counts raw accepted sockets; the difference is limited to transports that never reach the broker. The counter is atomic because listener tasks run outside the state mutex.
